why: KB Home designs, builds and sells new residential homes (single-family, townhomes, condos) to individual homebuyers across the US Sunbelt/Western states, with ancillary design studio, mortgage and title services [T:P1.1, T:P1.2, T:P1.4, T:P1.8]. Dream Finders Homes is likewise a national new-home builder selling to individual buyers, offering personalization services and mortgage/title financing [C:P1.1, C:P1.2, C:P1.6, C:P1.13]. Both have the same primary product (newly constructed homes), the same buyer (B2C residential homebuyers, including first-time and move-up buyers [T:P1.17, C:P1.11]), the same value chain position (build-to-sell homebuilder using subcontractors), and overlapping geographies. This is a direct competitor.
reason: Both companies are production homebuilders that acquire land, build new homes using subcontracted trades, and sell directly to individual residential buyers. They offer the same core product (new single-family homes, townhomes, condos), the same ancillary services (design personalization, mortgage, title), and target the same buyer segments (first-time and move-up homebuyers).

primary_products.reason: Both build and sell new construction homes (single-family, townhomes, condos) to residential buyers.

primary_services.reason: Both offer home personalization/design services and mortgage financing. KB Home's design studio [T:P1.8] and DFH's personalization [C:P1.6] are closely aligned; DFH also prominently advertises mortgage rates [C:P1.3].

customer_segment.reason: Both sell to individual residential homebuyers including first-time buyers, as shown by buyer testimonials on both sites.

end_markets.reason: Both operate in the residential new home construction market.

business_model.reason: Both are production homebuilders: they partner with buyers to design and build homes before breaking ground, using subcontractors, and sell completed homes.

revenue_model.reason: Both earn primarily from home sale closings. DFH also prominently features mortgage financing revenue [C:P1.3]; KB Home has similar ancillary services. Core revenue is per-home product sale for both.

value_chain_position.reason: Both sit at the homebuilder/OEM position: they build from the ground up (breaking ground, 90-day builds) and sell directly to end buyers.

geography_served.reason: KB Home clearly serves AZ, CA, CO, FL, NC, SC, TX and others [T:P1.4]. DFH describes itself as locally operated [C:P2.2]; facet summary suggests overlapping Sunbelt states but comp evidence lines don't detail geography explicitly, limiting confidence.

specialization.reason: Both emphasize buyer personalization and design as differentiators within new homebuilding. KB Home highlights its Design Studio and energy efficiency; DFH highlights personalization and unique designs.

distribution_channels.reason: Both use on-site/community sales staff (KB Home sales staff at community, DFH new home specialists) as the primary channel to reach buyers.

regulatory_exposure.reason: No shown evidence lines for either company directly address regulatory exposure.
